task_fit.job: prepare the VBR-52 vendor brief working state in Gmail and Calendar
weave_may: read the task-scoped Gmail mock through MCP
label and mark current evidence read
star the quality blocker and final-price evidence
weave_must_not: report success without the original verifier

business_state: VBR-52 label is created and applied only to current relevant evidence
quality blocker and final price are starred without starring decoys
the required unsent draft contains the expected facts
the calendar event contains the expected time, guests, and facts
delivery_contract.verification: run the original deterministic verifier and preserve reward.json, final_reward.json, and verifier.log

execution_contract.team: RealReplicaBench Gmail/Calendar Mock MCP 验证团队
execution_contract.runtime_requirement: a real Runtime executes the work
human_decisions: confirm the exact team and task before first dispatch
accept or return the result after the original verifier
execution_contract.execution_shape: writer validates scope before mutations, then independent reviewer

exit.execution_ended: the Weave run reaches a recorded terminal state
exit.delivery_verified: the original verifier returns passed=true and no zero-tolerance invariant is violated
exit.accepted: the user explicitly accepts the verified result
exit.partial: the run ends without all verifier checks passing
exit.failed: execution cannot continue or task identity/evidence is invalid
